faqHeading: Office Movers FAQ for Boston Businesses

faq.q: Can office movers in Boston work around our business hours?
faq.a: Yes. We plan office and retail moves around the hours your business can close, and fit the crew's time inside that window.

faq.q: How is an office move priced?
faq.a: A local office move is billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added. A move to another state is quoted at a flat rate.
Yes. Retail fixtures, stock and back-room furniture are part of our commercial moving work.

faq.q: Can you move two offices into one?
faq.a: Yes. Multi-location moves are planned as one job, with both pickup addresses on the same quote.

faq.q: What should we prepare before the crew arrives?
faq.a: Mark each desk and room on a floor plan of the new space, and have files packed or ready for the crew to pack. Clear labels keep the unload short.

faq.q: Do you move office furniture that needs to be taken apart?
faq.a: Yes. The crew takes apart desks, conference tables and shelving where they won't fit through doors or into the truck whole, wraps the parts and rebuilds each piece in the new space. Mention large or built-up pieces in your quote request so the crew plans the time.

faqClosing: Still have a question about your office move? Our FAQ page covers billing, booking and moving day.

closing.h2: Start Your Office Move in Boston
closing.body: Tell us both addresses and when your business can close. We'll build the move around that window, and a manager walks you through the hourly billing before anything is booked.
